title: Exclusively Ashton Drake Galleries 1999 Unforgettable Gene Doll Button Pin 1995
descriptionText: This is a rare and unique collectible item from Ashton Drake Galleries in 1999, featuring the Unforgettable Gene Doll. The doll comes with a button pin from 1995, adding to its charm and historical value. This piece was manufactured in Mexico and is not handmade. It falls under the category of collectible pinbacks and would make a great addition to any collection.
